acceptance: Loading a tuning YAML with an unknown top-level key fails with an actionable error (unit test with table_tuning typo).
context: Found 2026-10-13 by an adversarial review of tuning changes at origin/develop 77048bfb9.
description:
## Problem
`UnifiedTuningConfiguration.from_dict` (`benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py` ~L1255) ignores unknown top-level keys. A file with `table_tuning:` (a typo for `table_tunings:`) runs constraints-only and is still labelled `explicit_file`, and reconciliation sees nothing missing. a1458ee66 (#2712) catches only files that consist entirely of DataFrame keys.

## Change
- Reject unknown top-level keys (and unknown keys inside known sections) with an error naming the key and the nearest valid key.
- Allow an explicit, documented escape hatch only if a real need exists.
- Validate all shipped templates under the stricter rule.
